basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Halifax, Nova Scotia, with a passion for VR gaming and gadgetry. I've been a Redditor for over 5 years, actively participating in tech and gaming communities. I work as a network engineer by day, which gives me ample opportunities to explore new technologies. I'm single, and in my free time, I enjoy playing airsoft and participating in local tech meetups. I'm typically online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer networking and IT, having completed a degree in Computer Science and worked in the field for over a decade. My interest in VR started as a hobby, and I've self-taught myself the intricacies of VR systems through online resources and community engagement.
